title: betula pendula var. microlepis
intro: Betula pendula var. microlepis, commonly known as Silver Birch, is a variety of the Silver Birch tree native to Europe, known for its slender branches and distinctive silver bark. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Betula pendula var. microlepis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic effects, which can help soothe and protect the skin. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
